name: Allison Marston Danner
title: Associate Justice, California Court of Appeal, Sixth Appellate District
district: Sixth Appellate District (Santa Clara, Santa Cruz, Monterey, and San Benito counties)
years_of_service: Santa Clara County Superior Court 2012–2018; Sixth District Court of Appeal since 2018 (appointed by Gov. Jerry Brown). (Governor's office)
background: Danner earned a B.A. from Williams College (1993) and a J.D. from Stanford Law School. She clerked for Judge John T. Noonan Jr. of the Ninth Circuit (1997–1998) and for Justice John Paul Stevens of the U.S. Supreme Court (1998–1999). (Governor's office)

She taught criminal law and international law at Vanderbilt Law School (2001–2007), then was an Assistant U.S. Attorney in the Northern District of California (2007–2012), with a 2009–2010 detail to the Justice Department's Office of Legal Counsel. (Governor's office)

She was a Santa Clara County Superior Court judge from 2012 until Gov. Brown elevated her to the Sixth District in 2018. Voters retained her that year with 80.3%. She chairs the Judicial Council's Appellate Advisory Committee and the training seminars for new appellate justices. (Ballotpedia; Daily Journal)
